lines.zh: 我按着经书的节奏踱步
lines.en: I pace to the rhythm of the scripture
My robe's hem sweeps the ground

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，走得很慢
lines.en: I walk slowly, hands behind my back
I walk the wall's length on patrol

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩得土地很实
lines.en: My boots press the earth firm
I pause a step at the door
I push the wooden door open and enter

lines.zh: 我的护甲在走动时轻响
lines.en: My armor ticks as I move
I circle most of the courtyard
I press my hat brim down

lines.zh: 她伸手替我扶正了帽檐。
lines.en: She reaches up and sets my cap straight.
I head to the next post
I stand with my hands folded
I murmur a passage
Sunlight rests on my shoulder plate
I glance up at the bell tower
I rest my hand on the weapon at my belt

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在动
lines.en: I hear something moving far off
I smooth my cuff before speaking.
This corridor is quiet
My breathing is slow and even
I'm here for the change of watch
I stop and raise my eyes to you
I push the door open and check the floor.
This is Inquisition ground
I rest my hand on the hilt without drawing
State your business clearly

lines.zh: 我认得你的脸，不认得你的名
lines.en: I know your face, not your name
You're standing too near the door
I don't mind you passing through
Keep your hand out of your coat
I'm watching your eyes

lines.zh: 这一带不太平，你知道吧
lines.en: These parts are unsafe; you know that
Take your hat off when you address me
I step back and guard my ribs
I grit my teeth and make no sound
A corner of my robe is torn
I regrip the hilt

lines.zh: 审判庭的袍子破了一道。
lines.en: A tear in the Inquisition's robe.
My breathing grows heavier once
I start a line and stop

lines.zh: 我踩着石阶一级级上行。
lines.en: I climb the stone steps one by one.
I've retreated, but I'm not fleeing
I watch it, waiting for its answer
There's sea brine on you
That tissue; I shouldn't touch it
Put it away, quickly

lines.zh: 这不是能拿在手里的东西
lines.en: That's not a thing to hold

lines.zh: 我闻着它，脑子里有声音
lines.en: I smell it and hear a voice in my head

lines.zh: 带上它的人，最后都变了
lines.en: Those who carry it always change
Step back three paces before you speak
I won't put that in my mouth
Bury it; don't bring it into the city
I'll keep watch; be quick
You hit my shoulder plate
I take half a step and hold

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，谁也没倒
lines.en: We collide and neither falls
My hand steadies your elbow

lines.zh: 你的肩膀很硬，是练过的
lines.en: Your shoulder's hard; you've trained
I turn aside to let you pass
The door complains at our weight
You go around behind me

lines.zh: 我们脚步错开，各自站定
lines.en: Our steps part and we both stand
That wasn't a clash

lines.zh: 另一位修士在廊下等我
lines.en: Another priest waits under the gallery
We walk this stretch side by side

lines.zh: 我们没有牵手，只是靠近
lines.en: We don't hold hands; we only keep close

lines.zh: 它往侧面挪，我贴着墙跟。
lines.en: It shifts sideways; I track along the wall.

lines.zh: 我们一起念完那段祷文
lines.en: We finish the prayer together
Her voice is lower than mine
We stand at the door a long while
Tonight the watch is mine
She nods and turns away
We both know what must be done

lines.zh: 我屈身把它从地上拾起
lines.en: I stoop and lift it from the ground
Whose is this
I set it on the stone ledge
There's a slick residue on it
I wrap it in cloth before carrying
This must go to the tribunal
I hold it to the light to inspect
It doesn't belong here
I note where I found it

lines.zh: 你把它拿走吧，别掉在地上
lines.en: Take it, and don't drop it
That thing is moving by the wall
I've drawn my blade
Stand back; leave this to me
It's bigger than the last one I saw
I speak one short line
My boots are set
Fall back inside the door
I'll hold this side
It's coming this way
My sword hand is steady
Don't let it near the water
The people here aren't clear yet
I'm reading its movements
It looks ready to charge
I hold my blade across my body
The plate is caved inward.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把它逼回墙角
lines.en: I force it back toward the corner
My breathing hasn't broken
Its tendrils reach too far
I don't shout; shouting draws more
The door's behind me; I hold it
Its hide is tougher than it looks
I look for its joints
It has given ground once
My point stays on it
It wants my flank
I shift half a step and close it
The lamp still burns; good
When it overreaches, I go in
My blade comes down from the diagonal

lines.zh: 这一下砍在它的甲壳上
lines.en: This strike lands on its shell
It lunges; I shoulder it aside
I reverse the blade and open a line
Its blood spatters my robe
I step back and reset my stance
That cut finds nothing
I kick its forelimb away

lines.zh: 刀卡住了，我用力抽出来
lines.en: The blade sticks; I wrench it free
Its motion lags a beat
I press in with another cut
You strike from the side; good
I drive its head down
A line opens on my arm

lines.zh: 我往前踏一步，压住它的动线
lines.en: I step in and cut off its line
My flat strikes its joint
You've brought wild soil in on your soles.
I lower my brim and scan the area
I stand with my hand on the scripture
I push the door open first

lines.zh: 我看见地上有黏液的痕
lines.en: I see a trail of slime on the ground
I raise my head and read the wind
I take this watch
I set my hand on the hilt
Something has crossed the line
I'm patient; I wait for it to show

lines.zh: 我把刀鞘往腰后推了推
lines.en: I push the scabbard back on my belt
I count the ways out first
Fire takes my hem; I beat it out

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，护甲先响
lines.en: I fall from the steps and my armor rings first
Seawater floods my mouth and nose
The blast throws me against the wall
An arrow pierces my pauldron

lines.zh: 那股力量压住我的胸口
lines.en: That force presses on my chest

lines.zh: 我两天没进食，手有点抖
lines.en: Two days without food; my hand shakes

lines.zh: 雷打在我的刀上，手臂一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my blade and my arm goes numb

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我抓不到石栏
lines.en: No floor below; my hand finds no rail
